title: Handwashing procedure flow
basis: Order of recorded confirmation timestamps in sampled frames, not continuous action intervals

steps.label: Wet hands
steps.reason: The clip starts with soap in a palm. No sampled frame shows hands being wetted before soap is applied.

steps.label: Soap
steps.reason: A palm is held under a wall-mounted dispenser with a white dollop of soap visible on it.

steps.label: Rub / lather
steps.reason: The hands rub together with visible lather; another view shows one palm rubbing the back of the other hand.

steps.label: Rinse
steps.reason: A visible stream from the faucet falls onto the hands as they are held beneath it.

steps.label: Dry
steps.reason: Paper is pulled from a dispenser, then held between both hands as they are rubbed with it.

steps.label: Discard
steps.reason: The used paper towel is moved over the lined bin and lowered into its opening.
